# MoHeader

Headers for the phone: a 52pt bar for pushed screens and a 30pt large title for tab roots.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoHeader` · 14 Phone

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoHeader />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoHeader"></x-import>
```

## Notes

MoHeader: pushed-screen header, 52pt under the status bar: back, title + subtitle, up to two trailing actions. MoLargeTitle: 30/1.1 title on tab roots only; the subtitle counts running (live text) and needs you (ink, medium). @startingPoint section="Phone" subtitle="Headers and large titles" viewport="860x300"

| prop | type | note |

| `sub` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `onBack` | `() => void` | Shows the back button. |
| `left` | `React.ReactNode` | Leading content when there is no back button (the Conductor mark on Activity). |
| `right` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `flush` | `boolean` | Skip the status-bar inset (inside a sheet or a preview). |
